system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a Kubernetes Pod manifest for an nginx container with a securityContext that drops all capabilities, runs as a non-root user, and uses a read-only root filesystem.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Kubernetes manifest (YAML)

Task: Create a Kubernetes Pod manifest for an nginx container with a securityContext that drops all capabilities, runs as a non-root user, and uses a read-only root filesystem.

Output only the Kubernetes manifest (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: nginx-secure
  labels:
    app: nginx-secure
spec:
  automountServiceAccountToken: false
  securityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
    runAsUser: 101
    runAsGroup: 101
    seccompProfile:
      type: RuntimeDefault
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged:1.25-alpine
    imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    ports:
    - name: http
      containerPort: 8080
      protocol: TCP
    securityContext:
      allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
      capabilities:
        drop:
        - ALL
      readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 50m
        memory: 64Mi
      limits:
        cpu: 200m
        memory: 256Mi
    livenessProbe:
      httpGet:
        path: /
        port: http
        scheme: HTTP
      initialDelaySeconds: 10
      periodSeconds: 10
      timeoutSeconds: 2
      failureThreshold: 3
    readinessProbe:
      httpGet:
        path: /
        port: http
        scheme: HTTP
      initialDelaySeconds: 5
      periodSeconds: 5
      timeoutSeconds: 2
      failureThreshold: 3
    volumeMounts:
      - name: cache
        mountPath: /var/cache/nginx
      - name: run
        mountPath: /var/run
  volumes:
    - name: cache
      emptyDir:
        sizeLimit: "100Mi"
    - name: run
      emptyDir:
        medium: Memory
        sizeLimit: "10Mi"
  restartPolicy: Always
